title: Thundertree · Area 2 · Blighted cottages

sourceRecords.title: Thundertree 2 · Blighted cottages
read: Two collapsed homes stand side by side, their old rooms given over to brush and young trees.

The brush has grown across what used to separate the homes' rooms. Fallen walls still mark their old boundaries beneath the living growth. You can inspect a particular patch of rubble or keep together where the route between the two ruins is easiest to see.

brief: TWO adjacent collapsed cottage ruins, overgrown by dense brush and young trees; old living-room divisions still legible among fallen masonry and rotten beams. SIX twig blights remain concealed as ordinary brush. No opened coin chest, visible monsters or inhabited cottages. Daylight.
